readme_purpose: push-stream seam: readable-timestamp wait with lost-wake protection, bounded SSE framing with disconnect-propagating cancellation, cursor-after-apply checkpointing with revision-watermark idempotency

spot_checks.claim: wait_for_higher_ts(target) check-then-register under one lock with check-then-register pattern and race-free future ownership
spot_checks.verification: CONFIRMED - Line 612 calls notify_waiters(), line 614 checks if latest_ts <= target_ts under lock, lines 615-616 register oneshot channel if still needed, async block at 622-625 owns receiver for race-free semantics

spot_checks.claim: Every publish_commit wakes the snapshot manager via snapshot_manager.push()
spot_checks.verification: CONFIRMED - Line 1136 shows snapshot_manager.push(commit_ts, new_snapshot, write_bytes) called in every publish_commit path

spot_checks.claim: Every push() invocation calls notify_waiters() to wake all waiting tasks
spot_checks.verification: CONFIRMED - Line 753 shows self.notify_waiters() called in every push() invocation after version management

spot_checks.claim: data_sync.rs guarantees no-split transactions and per-document increasing timestamp order
spot_checks.verification: CONFIRMED - Lines 22 and 45 both state 'Transactions are not split across pages when advancing synced_ts', line 35-36 states 'Each rev of a given document will be emitted in increasing timestamp order'

spot_checks.claim: Liveness/select pattern using select_biased! between stream, timeout, and shutdown signals
spot_checks.verification: CONFIRMED - Lines 46-70 show select_biased! with three branches: entries_future (line 47), timeout (line 59), zombify_rx shutdown (line 66), exactly matching the pattern described for liveness monitoring

adequacy_analysis.readable_timestamp_wait: ADDRESSED - Section 1 details wait_for_higher_ts() derivative, check-then-register pattern, snapshot manager coordination, and lost-wake protection via atomic lock semantics
adequacy_analysis.lost_wake_protection: ADDRESSED - Achieved through check-then-register (notification always happens after registration or immediate satisfaction), documented at lines 14-30 with explicit cancel-safe select! guidance
adequacy_analysis.bounded_sse_framing: ADDRESSED - Section 3 proposes bounded channel(N) with try-send, disconnect detection, and SSE chunked encoding without Content-Length for proper disconnect propagation
adequacy_analysis.disconnect_propagating_cancellation: ADDRESSED - Lines 51-55 detail disconnect propagation via channel-based backpressure and SSE chunked framing (no Content-Length), with precedent from http_actions.rs
adequacy_analysis.cursor_after_apply: ADDRESSED - Section 4 documents atomic group-by-ts apply semantics at lines 65-71, with explicit ordering (truncations before values) and page boundary rules
adequacy_analysis.revision_watermark_idempotency: ADDRESSED - Lines 66-68 require revision watermark retention and dropping replayed_ts <= retained_ts for idempotent replay, with tombstone retention policy noted as planning question
adequacy_analysis.failure_handling: ADDRESSED - Section 5 maps expiry/validation errors to typed events, reuses cursor_expired_error mapping, and specifies error accounting per R10/R11
